story.text: im here.
its only a five minute walk luckily.
lets go to bed.
tomorrow is a new day.
lets hope it will be a better day.
its hard to keep my eyes open
not that surprising it's nine in the morning.
i need to sle...
d. ... hav. a......g you ..nt to t..k a....?
do ..u h.ve an...ing you w.nt to t.lk ab..t?
do y.u have anyt.ing you want to talk ab.ut?
do you have anything you want to talk about?
hello?
who are you?
i am you.
i am the one you keep talking to.
i dont understand.
you keep talking to me instead of others. for you are a coward.
talking with real people scares you so you make fictional conversations. with me.
so... do you have anything you want to talk about?
i.. i dont know.
well, that is useless. should i start then?
why do you keep doing this?
this is not the first time and will not be the last time.
what inside you makes you almost crave this feeling.
you could have stayed sober.
you could have just talked. socialized with your coworkers.
you already switched jobs to be more social. yet nothing changed.
the only difference now is that you can drink on the job. which is not an improvement.
you only fueled your own sleeplessness not to mention your substance abuse problems.
also you keep working yourself to the bone. you are working twice as hard as the rest for what?
so they dont get mad at you?
you are a wreck you know that?
i try to better myself i really do.
like when you tried to stay sober?
i... i sometimes just loose control.
i dont know how to explain it.
it just gives me this ease of mind.
all those negative taughts stop.
well that's not true. even drunk you keep bringing yourself down. so why drink?
because...
because?
i have no reason...
can you still remember the first time you drank?
vaguely, my parents where out to go somewhere and i was home alone.
you saw the bottle of rum.
and you drank all of it.
quite impressive, dont think you can even do that now.
maybe i remember it differently.
but more importantly, you didnt touch alcohol for years after that.
you still remember when you began again?
no...
it just happened.
slowly i started to drink again.
